text: I have been with Bank of America for a very long time I had my savings and checking Ive never overdraft or caused any problems. I had a credit card that started off with a {$300.00} balance was increased to {$800.00} always paid on time never late and the each and every time I go to apply for an increase in my credit card they always denied me, and Im not understanding I get a mortgage I get a car loan I get other credit cards without any problems but Bank of America for some reason keeps denying me I make good money. My credit is fine. My bills are paid so Im not understanding why they keep denying me. I can't help but feel that they're not doing their due diligence when verify my information or they are discriminating against me somehow.
